evidence: Packet receipts show successful SSH and HTTPS probe commands, but they do not substitute for a current inspectable push-to-deploy timing record.
findings.repair_instruction: Restore or expose a live deployment log or timestamp source (for example /var/log/git-deploy.log) and provide entries for both main and dev showing each push finished with duration_ms < 3000.
findings.summary: The current state does not expose the deployment log or equivalent timestamps needed to prove push-to-deploy completion within the 3-second window.

summary: The live SSH/HTTPS probes in the packet are encouraging, but the current read-only inspection of the deployment log path failed: /var/log/git-deploy.log was not found. That means there is no direct current-state timing evidence proving main and dev deployments completed within 3 seconds, which is a visible requirement.
